verdict.rationale: Bolna offers a full REST API, a dedicated CLI (single Go binary) for managing agents/calls/phone numbers/batches from the terminal, and BYOK/self-host options via Docker/Kubernetes, all of which support headless/CI-style automation. However, there is no explicit CI/CD example, no mention of exit codes, scripting patterns, or automation pipeline integration in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, headless automation guides, non-interactive scripting docs, and independent confirmation of CLI use in automated environments.
